sites.name: Markleeville Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $18 per night
sites.waterText: Yes, drinking water is available from a hand pump
sites.about: Located on Markleeville Creek, in the shade of Jeffrey pines and cottonwood trees. Generally open late April through early September as weather and conditions allow.

sites.restrictions: No RVs longer than 24 feet Site 4 day use only, can accommodate up to 6 people on first come first served. Site typically has a lot of standing water year-round. California camp fire permit required
sites.reservations: No reservations needed, first come, first serve.

sites.name: Centerville Flat Campground
sites.feeText: No fees are required for this site
sites.directions: From Markleeville, travel south/east of CA-89, then continue onto CA-4. Continue 2.5 miles and the site will be on your left.
sites.restrictions: California camp fire permit required ( https://www.fs.usda.gov/detail/htnf/passes-permits/?cid=fseprd673196 ). Dog must be on a leash at campground.
